unverified_boundaries: Agent routing and interactive behavior have not been runtime-evaluated.
Scientific benchmark performance, censoring robustness, and human-expert review have not been established.
The bundled self-test uses one six-subject hand-calculated comparison plus small fail-closed cases; representative studies, heavy ties, imbalanced cohorts, and large cohorts were not evaluated.
Endpoint, time-origin, censoring, and group semantics are caller declarations and are not independently verified.

The p-value uses platform libm through Python math.erfc, so its last binary floating-point digit is not promised across platforms; extreme finite tails are reported as structured underflow rather than exact zero.
Publication is create-new with checked exception rollback, not crash-atomic; same-directory hostile-writer races and Windows publication/symlink behavior have not been verified.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The event definition, elapsed-time origin or unit, or right-censoring rule is absent or ambiguous.
decision_sequence.question: What prespecified event, time origin, unit, and censoring rule do the fields represent?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Export one prespecified endpoint with elapsed time from its declared origin; code only that event as 1 and valid right censoring as 0.

decision_sequence.applies_when: The two fixed group labels or their construction is absent, ambiguous, or outcome-derived.
decision_sequence.question: Which two prespecified labels are the fixed comparison groups?
decision_sequence.recommended_answer: Use labels defined before inspecting outcomes; treat lexical group order only as a deterministic reporting direction.
